test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All schools are colleges.

No college is a radio.

**Conclusions: **

(I) Some colleges are schools.

(II) No school is a radio.
solution:
**Given:**

Statement 1: All schools are colleges

Statement 2: No college is a radio

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5729c7adaa35be72b6a23eaccb12eca671d4b86cf12995fe13cbded994a42f46.png] 

**Check Conclusion I:**

Some colleges are schools

⇒ If all schools are colleges, then at least some colleges must be schools

⇒ Conclusion I follows ✔

**Check Conclusion II:**

No school is a radio

⇒ Schools are part of colleges

⇒ No college is a radio

⇒ Therefore schools cannot be radio

⇒ Conclusion II follows ✔

**∴ Both conclusions I and II follow.**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 2.**
